method: Paired basic-bootstrap one-sided simultaneous upper bound across all feasible alternatives relative to fixed incumbent; accept only the existing expanded-search recommendation if its upper bound is strictly below zero. All nonfinite evidence -> retain incumbent.
incumbent: Previous within-group-variance procedure, with single EOG extension
challenger: Already frozen full-EOG-expansion recommendation; do not choose a different candidate with truth
historical_gate: No primary/raw regression at any start, some strict primary improvement, S005 recovers original-main primary/raw MSE at all starts. Otherwise reject, do not retune alpha.
next_gate: On seeds 5–9, no primary/raw regression against fresh within-variance baseline and some strict primary improvement. Then ten-person guardrail before any promotion.
limitations: Adaptive candidate generation and incumbent selection reuse data. Simultaneous bootstrap is an exploratory score-evidence safeguard, not guaranteed calibration or a bound on true MSE. New starts on the same two participants are not an independent cohort.
production: No production activation or merge; historical stage first, unseen-start stage pending.
